fact: Since 2021 Morocco's digitised targeting system, the RSU with about 5.2 million households registered, determines eligibility for both direct social transfers and free health insurance, with the RNP identifier linking the databases of the programmes' administrations.
title: الاقتصاد السياسي للبيانات الاجتماعية: فرص ومخاطر رقمنة منظومة الاستهداف بالمغرب
